text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. Going to eat lunch?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: That's right. I made it together with<n>my breakfast.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of lunches<n>Wonder Acute
makes. My<n>imagination (or stomach) starts<n>running
wild.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Say, if you haven't had lunch yet,<n>would you like to
join me? I could<n>use some help.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Sure as can be. I made a bit too much<n>today, so I'd
be delighted if you'd<n>take some of it off my plate.
choice_data_list: Don't mind if I do, then.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, <username>! A bunch of us were about to<n>grab lunch, you
want in? Apparently<n>the new ramen place by the
station is<n>pretty good.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I'll have to pass today.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Trainer, you don't have to decline<n>on my
account.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure we'll have plenty more<n>chances to share
a bento again. If<n>your company's wanted, you
ought<n>to go.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I've already made up my mind.<n>Thanking him for
the invite, I explain<n>to the other trainer that I have
plans to<n>eat lunch with Wonder Acute.
choice_data_list: I'll join you guys next time!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, okay, didn't know you already<n>had plans. Catch
you next time, then!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute lifts the lid off her<n>bento to reveal a
meal of Western<n>home cooking: bacon and cheese
sandwiches with meatloaf.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It all looks tempting, but a sandwich is<n>my first
victim. The thick slices of<n>bacon harmonize perfectly
with the<n>tomatoes and fragrant slices of rye<n>bread.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, my! Seeing such a look of delight<n>on your face
just warms my heart.<n>Try the tea too. I put it in a
thermos,<n>so it's nice and steamy.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As I take a few sips of tea, the<n>fragrance of the
leaves fills my<n>nostrils.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And for dessert, there's a cherry pie<n>with your
name on it. You can have as<n>much as you like.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, now that was a satisfying meal.<n>And the sun...
is shining just right...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Days like this make you want to lie<n>around in the
sun and take a nice nap.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Chirp, chirp!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the birds are out. Look at that,<n>what a cozy place
for a nest. The little<n>ones look full of life.
choice_data_list: Hope they grow up nice and healthy.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for spending time<n>with me. And
I'm sorry you had to<n>turn down that invitation.
choice_data_list: Don't be. I wanted to anyway.
Don't be. I wanted to anyway.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you don't have to pretend. You<n>really are the
most considerate<n>person, you know that?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Just like you did now, you always<n>find a way to put
me first in your<n>mind. Looking back, it's been like
that<n>ever since we met.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You noticed my quirk right away and<n>suggested a
better way I could be<n>stretching.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You looked at me with those keen<n>eyes of yours
and made a training<n>plan tailored just so to my
needs.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And to think, I get to have such an<n>incredible person
as my trainer—I<n>count my blessings every single
day.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But you know, I think it would do you<n>some good to
take things at your own<n>pace too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
When I see you going about your<n>business nice
and slow, that's what<n>really brings a smile to my
face.
choice_data_list: I mean, it's not like I'm—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Ding, dong...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, time sure flies by. I'll see you<n>after school,
then. Remember not to<n>overwork yourself, you
hear?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad she's looking out for me,<n>but it sounds
like there's a<n>misunderstanding that needs clearing
up.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's no rush. If we just take<n>things at our
own pace, I'm sure<n>we'll grow to understand one
another<n>in time.
